name: Orium
description:
About This Game

The universe is dying, galaxy after galaxy but capitalism won’t wait. On board your ship, your employer S-Corp expects you to meet revenue targets by exploiting every star system in your path. After all, just because the stars are fading away doesn’t mean business has to stop.

Explore a procedurally generated galaxy

Each expedition takes place in a brand new procedurally generated galaxy. As a captain hired by S-Corp, your mission is simple : generate as much profit as possible. Survive, stay profitable and keep your shareholders happy.

Exploit everything in your path

You only have 10 days to complete your mission, so make the most of this valuable time with your automated production facilities.

Expand the colony network

To expand the corporation’s commercial empire, you will need to visit stars and planets so that resource exploitation infrastructure can be deployed.

Beware of the scourge that plagues the universe

An elusive entity is slowly taking over the galaxy. You will have to carve your way through or face its minions and send them back to where they came from with a blast of laser.

Make smart decisions

Every action you take advances time and gradually increases the game’s difficulty. So think twice before you act.

Optimize your ship

Each battle strengthens your ship, and discoveries made across the galaxy can influence your chances of victory. And if you're in a bind, you can always visit your favorite coworker Bogg, who will gladly sell you upgrades at outrageous prices.

Fast and accessible gameplay

With streamlined controls and simplified 4X mechanics, exploration, expansion, and exploitation are just a few clicks away.

  • ~1 hour per expedition in a dying galaxy

  • Tens of thousands of stars waiting to be exploited

  • Multiple captains and starting weapons to shape your strategy

  • Various types of cosmic monsters standing in your way

  • Progressive upgrades earned through combat

  • Narrative events to refine your path to victory
short_desc: Aboard your ship, exterminate your enemies, exploit planets and weave your enterprise across the stars of a dying procedural galaxy. Orium is a Lovecraftian space roguelite, infused with streamlined 4X elements.
